expert_critique: The foundational design successfully targets the luxury architectural market using a dark, cinematic motif with a 3D Hero. However, the execution currently suffers from minor structural collisions (Hero overlap), typographic inconsistencies (Title Case vs Sentence Case), and compositional imbalance (Footer void). Applying a focused polish pass focusing on optical alignment, generous spacing (E1 Spacing Protocol), and refined typography will elevate this from a good functional site to a world-class experiential destination.

P0_critical_fixes.issue: Headline slightly overlaps the top ticker/marquee text.
P0_critical_fixes.fix: Increase the top padding of the hero container (e.g., add `pt-24` or `pt-32`). Verify z-index stacking context so the ticker is clearly separated. Use `mt-[header-height]` buffer if header is fixed.

P0_critical_fixes.issue: Stat row 'Lifetime PERFORMANCE WARRANTY' label collides with a 'SCROLL ↓' indicator.
P0_critical_fixes.fix: Reconfigure the bottom alignment. Anchor the SCROLL indicator strictly to `absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2`. Group the stat rows neatly to the left or distribute them with flex-wrap so they stack elegantly on narrower viewports without crossing the center axis.

P1_high_priority_polish.issue: Nav 'Speak to specifier' capitalization inconsistent with title case elsewhere.
P1_high_priority_polish.fix: Update to 'Speak to Specifier'. Apply `tracking-wide` and `text-sm` font-medium for a crisper, premium button appearance. Ensure hover state transitions smoothly (e.g., background shifts slightly lighter, text remains high contrast).

P1_high_priority_polish.issue: Footer right side next to logo appears largely empty (unbalanced).
P1_high_priority_polish.fix: Adopt a macro-grid for the footer. Place the vintage Meridian logo plate spanning 4-6 columns on the left. Expand the 4-column link grid to distribute evenly across the right side. Anchor the tagline block clearly to the bottom border spanning full width, or right-align it beneath the link columns to fill the void.

P1_high_priority_polish.issue: Mixed uppercase micro-labels and serif-italics need strict hierarchy.
P1_high_priority_polish.fix: Enforce `tracking-[0.2em]` or `tracking-widest` on all uppercase micro-labels (e.g., '— PERFORMANCE ✳') with a reduced size (`text-xs`). Ensure the serif-italic accent words sit cleanly on the baseline alongside bold sans headings.
Apply E1 generous spacing scale. Increase vertical gap between Performance table rows (`py-6` or `py-8` instead of standard `py-4`) to let the copper progress bars breathe.

P2_enhancements_and_micro_interactions.issue: Copper progress bars need cinematic reveal.
P2_enhancements_and_micro_interactions.fix: Add `framer-motion` `whileInView` to animate width from 0% to X% with a smooth, ease-out duration (e.g., 1.5s). Ensure the +% result chips fade in slightly after the bar finishes.

P2_enhancements_and_micro_interactions.issue: Carousel 'SCROLL TO TRAVERSE' indicator needs intuitive cue.
P2_enhancements_and_micro_interactions.fix: Add a subtle, infinite, 2px horizontal translation (pulsing left-to-right) to the indicator. Dim the counter (05/05) to `text-white/50` to maintain hierarchy.

P2_enhancements_and_micro_interactions.issue: Forms and WhatsApp buttons need tactile feedback.
P2_enhancements_and_micro_interactions.fix: Ensure all inputs have `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#c8824a]` and `focus:border-[#c8824a]`. Give the Floating WhatsApp button a hover state that slightly lifts (`-translate-y-1`) and drops a soft colored shadow (`shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(37,211,102,0.3)]`).

typography.headings: Bold geometric/humanist sans mixed with serif-italic accents.

components.buttons: Pill shape (`rounded-full`), 1px solid border or filled. Fill text must contrast heavily (e.g., dark text on copper background). Hover states must include subtle scale/brightness change.
components.chips: Subtle borders `border-white/10`, background `bg-white/5`, backdrop-blur if floating.
components.forms: Dark card backgrounds (`bg-white/5`), inputs with bottom-borders only or subtle rounded rectangles, placeholder text `text-white/40`.

motion.philosophy: Cinematic and deliberate. No fast, jarring moves.
motion.transitions: ease-out, 0.3s for micro-interactions, up to 1.5s for scroll reveals.
motion.touch_devices: Lenis/parallax/mix-blend disabled for iPad performance (Intentional constraint preserved).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT rebuild the site architecture or sections. Only apply these targeted polish fixes to the existing components.
Fix the P0 overlapping issues immediately (Hero headline and bottom stat row).
Fix the P1 layout issue in the Footer to eliminate the empty right-side void.
Fix the P1 typography issue in the Navigation ('Speak to specifier' -> 'Speak to Specifier').
Implement P2 micro-interactions for the Performance progress bars and Portal inputs.
Ensure all new or modified interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case.
